source: NHTSA ODI complaints API (api.nhtsa.gov/complaints/complaintsByVehicle), swept 2026-09-25/26: the 14 ruled makes for MY2000-2022, plus the known_issues.json vehicles outside that range
method: Regex shortlist (P code present, completed-repair verb near a component, recurrence cues excluded), in deterministic seeded order; the executor then read every shortlisted narrative in full. A case is accepted only when the narrative states a P code and a repair actually performed, and nothing says the repair failed to resolve the fault. The label comes from the component repaired, not from the DTC. The quote is the evidence; no label comes from model recall.
